title: PII Classification Compiler
description: Compiles the PII classification manifest for a data schema. Enforces: all fields are classified, highly-sensitive fields are encrypted at rest, sensitive fields are restricted from logging, no duplicate field IDs, and PII fields declare jurisdiction (GDPR, CCPA, etc.).

error_codes.PC001: pii-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: fields[] with id, name, classification
error_codes.PC002: One or more schema fields have no PII classification — all fields must be: none, low, medium, high, or critical
error_codes.PC003: Highly-sensitive PII field (SSN, payment, biometric) not flagged for encryption at rest
error_codes.PC004: Sensitive PII field not restricted from logging — mark logRestricted: true for medium+ fields
error_codes.PC005: Duplicate field ID found in PII manifest — field IDs must be unique
error_codes.PC006: PII field has no jurisdiction declared — specify applicable regulations: GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.
